plan.title: Interaction DE: treatment x time in cell-line RNA-seq
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — does the treatment effect differ between t0 and t1 — is an interaction question in a 2x2 design (condition x time) with 3 replicates per cell (12 samples total, single batch). This is answered by DESeq2 with a full factorial design (~condition*time), testing the condition:time interaction coefficient as the primary result, alongside the two simple effects (treatment vs control at t0, and at t1) that decompose the interaction. Data are raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples; the profiled counts.csv is gene-symbol indexed, not tximport transcript-level output, so the model runs directly on the provided integer matrix rather than re-importing from quant.sf, which is not among the staged inputs). With only 3 replicates per cell, statistical power for the interaction term is inherently low (a difference-of-differences with amplified standard error) — the plan surfaces this explicitly rather than loosening thresholds. QC precedes the model (blind VST + PCA + sample-distance heatmap) to confirm the four groups separate and no batch/outlier confounds the 2x2 structure. After DESeq2 fits the interaction model, ashr shrinks the interaction and simple-effect log2FCs (contrasts, not single coefficients, so ashr rather than apeglm), BH-FDR at 0.05 with independent filtering is applied per contrast, and fgsea preranked GSEA (ranking on the Wald statistic) runs separately for the interaction contrast and each simple effect against MSigDB Hallmark (staged, 50 sets) with WikiPathways human (staged) as a second collection. A final report step consolidates the three parallel result tables (interaction + 2 simple effects), the diagnostic plots, the explicit power caveat for n=3/group and for the interaction term specifically, and full reproducibility metadata. No translational/immune/PK-specific steps are added — the research question is a pure differential-expression / interaction question with no compound, biomarker-outcome, safety, or immune-composition angle stated.
